terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, APIs, paths, keys, placeholders, and versions remain unchanged.
Neutral Latin American Spanish uses control, botón, asignación, ranura, mouse, archivo, carpeta, and configuración.
Immediate Press is Pulsación; release-based Tap is Pulsación breve; Doble pulsación, Triple pulsación, and Pulsación prolongada remain distinct.
A completed pulsación prolongada suppresses the pulsación breve action, and lower-count sequences wait only for the configured interval.
Input listening uses detectar or esperar un control and never screenshot or media-capture terminology.
Captura de pantalla, captura, repetición, búfer de repetición, clip, grabación, and reproducción denote distinct media concepts.
Galería, biblioteca multimedia, superposición, foco, carpeta supervisada, and ubicación de almacenamiento remain contextually distinct.
Database terminology uses clave foránea, esquema, integridad, transacción, cadena, and arreglo.
Update security uses manifiesto, suma de comprobación, SHA-256, firma, confianza, HTTPS, revalidación, preparation, and finalization wording.
Internal transactional publish operations use finalizar, aplicar, or guardar en la ubicación definitiva rather than public-release wording.
The system tray is the bandeja del sistema, and startup text explicitly describes minimized tray startup.
The native launcher uses iniciador consistently with the v0.7.7 release-note surface.
